text: たいりょく　には　じしん　あるぜえ…　こいよ！

patterns.name: 〜に自信がある
patterns.span: たいりょく　には　じしん　ある
patterns.explanation: The thing you are confident about takes に, then じしんがある 'have confidence'; が is dropped here. たいりょく　には　じしん　ある = 'I'm confident in my stamina'.

patterns.name: 〜命令形
patterns.explanation: こい is the blunt order form of くる 'to come', softened a little by よ. こいよ = 'come on!'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, manly emphasis, drawled out here as ぜえ. じしん　あるぜえ = 'I've got confidence, I tell ya'.
